red_tests.failure_fingerprint: AssertionError: /admin/provider-pools is missing from the Rust routing table
40 routes in Python OpenAPI are NOT in the Rust gateway routing table

rationale: Contract test prevents route drift between Rust gateway (route_kind allowlist) and Python FastAPI (OpenAPI). Root cause of production 404 on /admin/provider-pools was a closed routing allowlist that was never updated after route additions in Python.
